methodology.summary: Growth 50%, quality 20%, valuation 15%, technical 15%, with a high revenue-growth floor. This uses the Stockmonk growth score and reported revenue growth; it does not claim quarter-on-quarter acceleration.
paragraphs: Revenue Momentum Leaders is constructed only from the existing Stockmonk US coverage universe. Intended investment horizon: 3-5 years. Every selected company passed the strategy's sector, size, liquidity and score-coverage screens.

Eligible US-listed companies are ranked with the Stockmonk four-factor scores: Growth 50% · Quality 20% · Valuation 15% · Technical 15%. Growth 50%, quality 20%, valuation 15%, technical 15%, with a high revenue-growth floor. This uses the Stockmonk growth score and reported revenue growth; it does not claim quarter-on-quarter acceleration.  The highest-ranked names are selected subject to a 8% single-stock cap and a 35% sector guide. Weights use score-proportional sizing. The portfolio is reviewed quarterly.

No ETF, mutual fund or non-US-listed security is eligible. Missing data is not filled with an estimate. A company without a full research report remains eligible only where the quantitative strategy calls for it, and its constituent card links to score evidence rather than a research report.
The performance shown is a current-constituent simulation, not a live track record. Rebalancing proposals are generated from the same rules and remain proposed until a future review is executed.
